proposal.reason: Main functional change is in logical graph channel/ring construction and mapping: src/graph/connect.cc adds channelMap propagation, fixes compCap80/89 channel shuffle behavior, and moves reverse-ring application to postset rank/node wiring; src/graph/search.cc switches net/proxy selection to graph->channelMap and validates cached proxy by send-rank+NIC match before fallback path lookup. This is core graph construction/connection correctness, so graph-search takes priority. src/init.cc and src/include/graph.h changes are supporting wiring/state for the same behavior, not an independent module contract change.
